title: Concorde Grew Almost a Foot Longer Every Time It Flew

scenes.text: Concorde grew almost a foot longer every time it flew.
At twice the speed of sound, air friction heated the nose to about 127 degrees Celsius.
Hot metal expands. So the whole plane stretched, by up to 12 inches.
Inside, a gap opened between the flight engineer's console and the wall.
On the final flights, engineers tucked their caps into that gap before it cooled. The caps are still there.
Concorde: the plane that was longer in the air than on the ground.

description:
Concorde grew almost a foot longer every time it flew.
At Mach 2, air friction heated the aluminium skin so much that the whole airframe stretched by several inches, and a gap opened up inside the cockpit. Engineers on the retirement flights slid their caps into it before it cooled.
Would you have flown on Concorde?
first_comment: Would you pay for a Concorde ticket if it flew again?
